attribution: Conversation sentences from the Malayalam Speech Corpus by Swathanthra Malayalam Computing, CC BY-SA 4.0.
verdict_reason: 203 everyday spoken-style Malayalam sentences written for the project. Too small to matter for training, and the only openly licensed conversational Malayalam found, so it is worth more as a held-out set.
used_for: Held-out conversational Malayalam for LM evaluation and as a seed for chat-golden.
